scope: Adjacent concept discovery beyond the pinned public curriculum; no trial availability or clinical recommendation inferred.

queries.query: Which original studies and regulatory analyses identify common oncology misunderstandings about companion diagnostics, test clinical utility, investigator-sponsored studies, investigational authorization versus marketing approval, and trial-site or cohort access?

Which primary cancer-biology experiments expose important distinctions between gene dosage, transcription, RNA processing, protein localization, receptor binding and cell behavior that are needed to interpret molecular tests?

Which original pathology and clinical-methods studies distinguish specimen orientation, inked margins, sampling, residual tumor cellularity, nodal deposits and treatment response in breast cancer pathology?

Which original cancer-biology studies distinguish cell of origin, cell state, clonal evolution, lineage plasticity, tissue invasion, tumor dormancy and metastatic colonization, including limits of extrapolating models?

Which primary method studies identify overlooked distinctions in RNA and cell-therapy product characterization, delivery, process comparability, analytical method validation, impurities, stability and potency?

Which original statistical methods studies explain common oncology errors involving causal estimands, intercurrent events, treatment-effect interactions, competing risks, repeated biomarkers, calibration and clinical utility?

Which original immunology experiments distinguish central and peripheral tolerance, antigen display and recognition, co-stimulation, T-cell activation, exhaustion, memory, receptor specificity and immune-mediated tumor killing?

Which original methods studies show overlooked interpretation limits in spatial and single-cell omics, DNA copy number and loss of heterozygosity, RNA isoforms, phosphoproteomics, immune assays and functional tumor models?

Which primary studies identify important distinctions across next-generation oncology payloads, targeted degradation, immune agonists, metabolic and epigenetic agents, radiation biology, therapeutic delivery and mechanism-specific resistance?
Which original receptor pharmacology experiments distinguish ligand binding affinity, receptor occupancy, agonist efficacy, constitutive activity, signaling kinetics and cell behavior?

queries.query: Which original single-cell lineage tracing experiments show why similar gene expression states do not establish common ancestry, future cell fate or a genetic clone?

rules: Every result occurrence receives a disposition.
A semantic result is not verified evidence.
New concepts enter the same coverage ledger.
Registry sweeps are added for any program, trial, access or current-status claim.
Two full review passes without a new unrepresented learning requirement are required for scoped completion.
